src/agent_runtime/special_actions.py

Python · Tier A

Task-owned composer actions, accepted from literal-free user input only.

Details

An action is scoped to the admitted task and its continuations. It is never inferred from history, attachments, parameter expansion or model output.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
action_mentions 17 Not yet documented
memory_mentions 25 Not yet documented
capture 29 Capture new-work defaults once; reparsing uses the admitted snapshot. Public admission passes its settings store, or an accepted prepared snapshot. Execution/compilation pass neither and retain the captured default. Old tasks without the additive field keep their historical opt-in behavior.
without_memory_action 64 Keep the shortcut out of imperative detection while preserving quoted examples.
skips_memory 71 Skip automatic recall/guidance, never access to explicit Memory tools.
